Class SlotGroupPanelAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.slotkit.api.group.SlotGroupPanelAdapter
public final class SlotGroupPanelAdapter extends Object
Anchors a Panel to slot groups and slots on container screens: a toolbar above the player inventory, a readout beside the hotbar, a slot above the offhand. Built on MenuKit's anchors: each group or slot is one Anchor whose box is on the open screen this frame, so panels on one group share a host and stack. 
Panel toolbar = Panel.builder("mymod:toolbar")
        .add(...)
        .in(ModeScope.BOTH, SlotPlacement.group(SlotGroupCategory.PLAYER_INVENTORY,
                PanelPosition.region(OutsideRegion.TOP_ALIGN_RIGHT)))
        .build();
new SlotGroupPanelAdapter(toolbar);

Placement is the panel's

Since 2.1.0 the panel's placements say where it goes, one per mode scope: SlotPlacement.group(SlotGroupId, PanelPosition) around a group's box, SlotPlacement.slot(Address, int, int) at an offset from one slot. The two modes can differ entirely. The panel shows where its current mode's group or slot is on the open screen, and nowhere else. A group or slot has no screen spots, so screenAnchor, main() and unplaced panels are rejected at construction.

new AnchorPanelAdapter(panel) places such a panel too. This adapter is the slot-aware form: it also warns when a panel holding slots on a group's region leaves its gap unset (only with the deprecated targeting today).

Targeting

Nothing besides the placements. The deprecated on(SlotGroupCategory...) and onGroup(SlotGroupId...) put the panel's screen placements around each named group instead, in both modes, and show it once per targeted group present on the screen.

Claims

A slot-group panel claims points by the same rule as every other panel: an opaque one over a slot makes that slot inert (its hover, click and tooltip).

Frozen after init

Construction, targeting and unregister() throw once MenuKit's declarations freeze at client start. Gate at runtime with Panel.visibleWhen(BooleanSupplier).
